$comment: Generated by apps/ui3/src/play/test/purchaseGuardVectors.test.ts (UPDATE_PURCHASE_GUARD_VECTORS=1). Every guard of an in-world purchase agrees with these at `now` on the outcome (sign, send or refuse) of checking a payload against an intent it already trusts; `refusal` is the TypeScript guard’s message, for reference. Only a refusal counts as refusing: any other error, or a panic, is a failure.
